messages:
jordan: Deploy-bot kicked off a phased rollout for service `serve-nx` -> v3.4.1 in the change window. Canary at 5% (us-east + eu-west). Observability hooks enabled: p95 latency, error-rate, 5xx. tagging @lia @mike @anna
deploy-bot: canary started · id=deploy-4309876543 · checks=[slo-p95,slo-errors,trace-sampling] · dashboard: https://dash/reports/serve-nx/canary
lia: watching dash now, will monitor traces + logs. I can flip autoscale if p95 climbs.
mike: saw a small error bump in eu-west, error-rate 0.2% -> 0.9% over 90s. p95 latency creeping from 120ms -> 225ms. Not seeing client 4xx.
anna: are these 5xx gateway or application? any stack traces?
mike: mostly 502/504 from gateway. quick log sample: ```
ERROR kvcache: kvcache.get timeout=200ms key=prefix:abc123
WARN gateway: upstream timeout id=svc-2345 status=504
```
jordan: thanks. Lia, can you check kvcache metrics? maybe cold cache or eviction pattern. Mike, hold additional traffic until we triage.
lia: kvcache write latency spiked in eu-west around deploy start, eviction rate jump x3. Suggest increasing kvcache request timeout to 400ms and retry policy for canary instances. Can try a config patch and re-run smoke.
mike: I can run a quick smoke after patch. sample smoke: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://serve.internal/embed?text=test`
ops-bot: alert (canary-error-rate): canary error-rate > 0.5% for 2m in eu-west. paging oncall.
jordan: decision call: pause expansion, do NOT push beyond 5%. Lia to apply config patch on canary subset in eu-west; if smoke green, resume ramp. If not, rollback eu-west to v3.4.0. Mike, run smoke and post results.
lia: patching kvcache timeout now: ```kubectl -n infra patch configmap serve-nx-cache --patch '{"data":{"timeout_ms":"400"}}'``` applying to canary subset via labels `deploy=canary-4309876543`
mike: smoke after patch -> `200 0.14` on 5 consecutive requests. p95 down to 130ms, error-rate back to 0.15%. Looks good in us-east too.
jordan: ok, resume ramp to 20% in eu-west AFTER 10m stable window. Deploy-bot, resume step when stable.
deploy-bot: resume scheduled in 10m · monitoring window start=4309876943 · will auto-abort if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms.
anna: passing note — create follow-up ticket to add kvcache integration test with injected latency, to prevent future regressions.
lia: creating ticket: https://board/tickets/RED-4521 "kvcache latency integration test"
mike: adding a quick blameless note to the release notes about the kvcache sensitivity and the mitigation we applied.
jordan: good work. if we see recurrence during ramp, we revert eu-west to v3.4.0 and open a postmortem. tagging #postmortems for visibility. :thumbsup:
